labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

fdcan_kernel_clock.title: FDCAN kernel clock frequency
fdcan_kernel_clock.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree.

auto_retransmission.title: Automatic retransmission
auto_retransmission.description: Automatic retransmission of frames that have lost arbitration or been disturbed by errors during transmission.

transmit_pause.title: Transmit pause
transmit_pause.description: When enabled, the peripheral pauses for two CAN bit times after successfully transmitting a message before starting the next transmission.

protocol_exception.title: Protocol exception
protocol_exception.description:
When enabled, this causes the operation state to change from Receiver state to Sync state at the next sample point.
When disabled, a recessive "res." bit is treated as a form error, and the FDCAN responds with an error frame.

std_filters_nbr.title: Standard filter number
std_filters_nbr.description: Number of standard message ID filters.

ext_filters_nbr.title: Extended filter number
ext_filters_nbr.description: Number of extended message ID filters.

filter_standard.title: Standard frame filters

Store in Rx FIFO 1 if filter matches

filter_id1.title: Filter ID1
filter_id1.description:
Filter ID1.

filter_id2.title: Filter ID2
filter_id2.description:
Filter ID2.

filter_extended.title: Extended frame filters
filter_extended.source: Array.from({ length: $basic.frame_filters.ext_filters_nbr}, (_, i) => ({ id: ('Extended filter' + i ) }))

oneOf.title: Classic filter: ID1 = filter, ID2 = mask
Dual ID filter. Matches only ID1 or ID2
Range filter from ID1 to ID2, extended ID AND mask (XIDAM) is applied
Range filter from ID1 to ID2, extended ID AND mask (XIDAM) not applied
Store in Rx FIFO 0 if filter matches
Store in Rx FIFO 1 if filter matches
Set high priority if filter matches

Set high priority and store in FIFO 1 if filter matches

filter_id1.description:
Filter ID1.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x1FFFFFF.

filter_id2.title: Filter ID2
filter_id2.description:
Filter ID2.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x1FFFFFF.

actions.message: The filter ID2 must be higher or equal to filter ID1.

global_filter_config.description: Frame acceptance or rejection rules for the defined filters.

acceptance_non_matching_std.title: Acceptance for non-matching standard frames
acceptance_non_matching_std.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for the standard frames that did not match the defined filters.

acceptance_non_matching_ext.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for the extended frames that did not match the defined filters.

acceptance_remote_std.title: Acceptance for standard remote frames
acceptance_remote_std.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for all standard remote frames.

acceptance_remote_ext.title: Acceptance for extended remote frames
acceptance_remote_ext.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for all extended remote frames.

clock_divider.description: It can only be modified by the first FDCAN instance.

fdcan_clk.title: FDCAN clock

nominal_prescaler.title: Prescaler
nominal_prescaler.description:
The value by which the kernel clock is divided for generating the nominal bit time quanta.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 512.

nominal_time_seg1.title: Time segment 1
nominal_time_seg1.description:
The number of nominal time quanta in Bit Segment 1.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 256.

nominal_time_seg2.title: Time segment 2
nominal_time_seg2.description:
The number of nominal time quanta in Bit Segment 2.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128.

nominal_jump_width.title: Sync jump width
nominal_jump_width.description:
Maximum number of nominal time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a data bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128 and can be manually changed if needed.

nominal_bit_time.title: Obtained bit time
nominal_bit_time.description: Nominal bit time in ns with current configuration.

nominal_bitrate.title: Obtained bitrate
nominal_bitrate.description: Output bitrate for the nominal phase in kbps with current configuration.

nominal_sample_point.title: Obtained sample point
nominal_sample_point.description: Location of the sample point in the nominal bit time segment with current configuration.

data_prescaler.title: Prescaler
data_prescaler.description:
Value by which the oscillator frequency is divided for generating the data bit time quanta.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 32.

data_time_seg1.title: Time segment 1
data_time_seg1.description:
Number of data time quanta in Bit Segment 1.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 32.

data_time_seg2.title: Time segment 2
data_time_seg2.description:
Number of data time quanta in Bit Segment 2.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 16.

data_jump_width.title: Sync jump width
data_jump_width.description:
Maximum number of data time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a data bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 16 and can be manually changed if needed.

data_bit_time.title: Obtained bit time
data_bit_time.description: Data bit time in ns with current configuration.

data_bitrate.title: Obtained bitrate
data_bitrate.description: Output bitrate for the data phase in kbps with current configuration.

data_sample_point.title: Obtained sample point
data_sample_point.description: Location of the sample point in the data bit time segment with current configuration.

tx_delay_comp_offset.title: Offset
tx_delay_comp_offset.description:
Offset value defining the distance between the measured delay from FDCAN_TX to FDCAN_RX and the secondary sample point.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 127 mtq (minimum time quantum).

tx_delay_comp_win_length.title: Window length
tx_delay_comp_win_length.description:
Maximum number of time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128 mtq.

enable_timeout_counter.title: Timeout counter
enable_timeout_counter.description: 16-bit timeout counter to signal timeout conditions for Rx FIFO 0, Rx FIFO 1, and the Tx event FIFO.

oneOf.title: Timeout controlled by Tx Event FIFO

timeout_period.title: Timeout period
timeout_period.description: Start value of the timeout counter (down-counter). Set the timeout period.

timestamp_prescaler.title: Timestamp prescaler
timestamp_prescaler.description: Timestamp counter time unit in multiples of CAN bit times.

enable_rx_fifo_operation_mode.title: Set Rx FIFO operation mode
enable_rx_fifo_operation_mode.description: Modify the default Rx FIFO operation mode.

tx_complete_buffer.title: Tx complete IT buffer(s)
tx_complete_buffer.description: Select the buffer(s) concerned by the Tx complete interrupt.

tx_abort_complete_buffer.title: Tx abort complete IT buffer(s)
tx_abort_complete_buffer.description: Select the buffer(s) concerned by the Tx cancellation complete interrupt.

it_error_logging_overflow.title: Overflow of FDCAN error logging counter occurred

it_ram_watchdog.title: Message RAM Watchdog event due to missing READY

it_arb_protocol_error.title: Protocol error in arbitration phase detected

it_data_protocol_error.title: Protocol error in data phase detected
